start: A member's page in an online gym, signed in as the owner; the member uses the app and has a join date

steps.action: Scroll to the card 'Full workout history'
user_sees: 'Ask this member to send their workouts from the app. Only workouts from the day they joined your gym are included.'
Button 'Request workout report'
must_not: The card in a gym that is not online

steps.action: Tap 'Request workout report'
user_sees: 'Asking…', then 'Asked on <today>. Waiting for the member to say yes in the app.' and 'Workouts since <join day>, the day they joined.'
The request button is gone while one is waiting
must_not: Two requests from a double tap
Any workout shown before the member says yes

steps.action: The member says yes in the app; open the page again
user_sees: 'The member said yes. The report is on its way.', then 'Sent on <day>: 12 workouts, from <first day> to <last day>.' in green
'You can download it until <day>.'
Button 'Download full history'
must_not: Workouts from before the join date counted
'1 workouts'

steps.action: Tap 'Download full history'
user_sees: 'Downloading…', then a file 'workout-report-<member name>-<sent day>.csv' that opens in Excel with names readable
must_not: Another member's workouts in the file
A cell that runs as a formula when opened

start: A member's page where a report was sent five days ago (the download way in)

steps.action: Open the member's page
user_sees: The green 'Sent on …' line, 'You can download it until …', 'Download full history' and a quieter 'Request workout report'
must_not: The download offered for a request that was only asked, not sent

steps.action: Tap 'Download full history'
user_sees: The same file as before
must_not: A fresh ask sent to the member by a download

start: A member's page, card 'Full workout history'

steps.action: Ask for a member with no join date and no plan
user_sees: 'This member has no join date or plan yet. Add one first, then ask again.'
must_not: A request for the member's whole life of workouts

steps.action: Ask the same member many times in one day
user_sees: 'You have asked this member many times today. Try again tomorrow.'
must_not: The member's phone asked again and again

steps.action: Turn the internet off and tap 'Request workout report'
user_sees: 'Couldn’t reach the server. Check the internet and try again.'
must_not: 'Asked on …' for a request that did not go

steps.action: Ask while the gym's account is on hold
user_sees: 'Your gym account is on hold, so you can’t ask for reports now.'
must_not: The request going through

steps.action: Open the card after signing out on another tab
user_sees: 'You have been signed out. Sign in again.'
must_not: A blank card

start: A member's page with an earlier request in each state

steps.action: Open a member who said no
user_sees: 'The member said no on <day>. No report was sent. You can ask again later.' and the request button
must_not: Any file to download

steps.action: Open a member who never answered for 30 days
user_sees: 'No report came within 30 days. You can ask again.'
must_not: The request still shown as waiting

steps.action: Tap 'Download full history' on a report sent 31 days ago
user_sees: 'This report is more than 30 days old and was removed. Ask again for a new one.'
must_not: The old file still handed out

steps.action: With a sent report still inside its 30 days, tap 'Request workout report' again
user_sees: The new 'Asked on …' line, and the earlier report still downloadable until its day
must_not: The earlier report's download gone the moment a new ask is made

steps.action: Open a member whose report holds no workouts
user_sees: 'Sent on <day>: 0 workouts (nothing logged since joining).'
must_not: A download of an empty file with no word

start: A member who trained at another gym before joining this one

steps.action: Ask for the report
user_sees: The member's app asks first; nothing is sent unless the member says yes
must_not: A report sent without the member's yes
The ask repeated after a no on the same day

steps.action: Download the report
user_sees: Only workouts from the day the member joined this gym
must_not: Workouts logged before joining, or at another gym

steps.action: Look at who can download it
user_sees: Only people signed in to this gym, for 30 days after it was sent
must_not: The file open to another gym's sign-in
The file kept after 30 days
